title: Orchestrator connector circuit & recursion mitigator for multi-tool executions
creator: Marco Chen
description: Design and implement an orchestration layer extension that safely manages multi-tool connector chains. This ticket adds a circuit-style mitigator and recursion detection to the tool execution loop so that long-running or cyclic tool graphs are cut off gracefully, injected results are validated, and streaming responses remain consistent. The work spans runtime guards, structured output contracts, and a compatibility shim for older connectors that do not emit structured metadata.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can detect cycles in a chain of tool invocations within a single request and terminate with a clear structured error payload (no unbounded CPU or memory growth)
A per-request hop-count and invocation-id are included in tool RPC headers and logged in trace spans for post-mortem analysis
Injected tool results are validated against declared structured-output schemas; mismatches trigger a safe-fallback path with a deterministic error response
Streaming responses from tool chains preserve order and include consistent intermediate sentinel frames when a circuit breaker trips
Backwards-compatible shim: connectors lacking schema metadata fall back to 'opaque' mode and are rate-limited and sandboxed until adapter upgrade
Automated integration tests simulate recursion, resource exhaustion, and malformed injection and assert graceful degradation and observability signals
implementation_notes: Introduce lightweight invocation metadata: {request_id, invocation_id, hop_count, origin_connector} added to each tool call header
Hop-count threshold: default 12 (configurable per-customer); when exceeded, emit structured 'recursion_limit' error and stop further tool calls
Circuit state machine per-request: OPEN / MONITORING / CLOSED. 'OPEN' triggers fast-fail and emits telemetry events to console dashboard

Result injection validation: connectors must declare an output schema (OpenAPI-like JSON schema). If present, runtime validates using fast-json-schema library; failures route to fallback_model with clear diagnostic
Streaming guard: introduce 'sentinel' stream frame type ('__breaker__') and a finalization frame containing truncation_reason so clients can handle partial results
Compatibility shim: adapter layer annotates legacy connector responses with minimal metadata (inference: 'opaque' type, checksum) and enqueues them into a slower execution path with stricter quotas
Telemetry: add spans and logs for invocation_id and hop_count; include aggregated metrics (cycles_detected, injections_rejected, shims_used) in runtime-telemetry table
Testing: fuzz tool chains to provoke self-invocation patterns, simulate long tokenizer stalls, and validate memory boundedness under load
